algebra.recover: Re-run the same hop after fix. Never waive and proceed.
algebra.reports: Harness-generated only. Bound to this package_dir + input file hashes. Prerequisite reports need non-empty checks that match a live hop re-run (id+PASS stubs are REJECT). Prerequisite ACCEPT is decideVerdict(checks); the self-certified verdict field is not trusted. Any P0 FAIL in checks is prereq REJECT. Forged, grafted, empty-check, or stale reports are REJECT. R3 re-scans current CV/CL/Brief/Profile HTML and independently re-verifies VI provenance; disk ACCEPT cannot waive those gates. Supervisors must --verify (or a fresh --hop R3) before ATS fill; a disk R3.json verdict is never sufficient. --verify re-runs R3 live, re-derives decideVerdict, and REJECTs missing, handwritten, or disk-vs-live disagreement.

hops.name: VI distill
hops.notes: VI distill needs source URL + date + exact hex/font/radius AND usage notes (how primary is a wordmark/field on the canvas). Token-only hex/font is REJECT. Chrome-only Giant Spoon distill is REJECT even if hex/font match — work/case content (video cards, duotone scrims, real gradients) must be in the record. Home hero type-only white is chrome, not the brand. When profile HTML is present, primary must be applied as a real field/wordmark; a black/white/navy résumé is REJECT.

hops.name: Profile
hops.notes: Qualifying live evidence required: HTTP 2xx AND body contains dedicated-profile path identity (/{slug}/ or ai.drsfilms.com/{slug}). Company-word mention alone is not enough. Local profile.html alone is REJECT. SPA 200 empty shell is FAIL. --fetch-profile 4xx/5xx/timeout/error is FAIL. Self-test may inject fetchResult. Profile HTML (local and live) must contain real work stills; text-only / empty / placeholder is REJECT. Images are not optional. Hung files require assets.json external_ready:true AND INDEX public:true. 58-node file only on /wonder/ until generic public. DEV4 UIs are public:false. Visible A-* ids REJECT. Also REJECT token-only VI, text-only showreel cards, legal-paragraph credits, and JD-archetype invocation misses. Every new Profile is judged against the newest 3 shipped public/*/index.html peers (git last-touch, mtime fallback); manifest compared_to must record that moving bar — a frozen ElevenLabs/Luma or Wonder/Kalshi pair is REJECT when newer pages exist. A résumé/text page is REJECT when any of those 3 has a first-viewport still.

hops.name: Closeout
hops.notes: ACCEPT means CV + CL + a real company Profile exist and match this package now, with qualifying live evidence (2xx + dedicated-profile path identity). Prior reports must be harness-generated, bound, fresh, and reproduce live hop evidence (not id+PASS stubs). R3 independently re-runs claim-lock, slop, skip-language, waiver, and R-VI provenance on current files. Supervisor --verify re-runs this hop live and re-derives decideVerdict; missing, handwritten, or disagreeing disk R3.json is REJECT.

profile_url.evidence: qualifying live HTTP 2xx whose body contains dedicated-profile path identity (/{slug}/ or ai.drsfilms.com/{slug}); company-word mention alone is not enough; local HTML alone is not enough; SPA 200 empty shell is FAIL
